mapper.sql: select id, order_no, submit_key, pickup_token, pickup_display, pickup_date, user_id, shop_id, order_type, scheduled_pickup_time, order_status, pay_status, refund_status, product_amount, pack_fee, total_amount, remark, pay_time, accept_time, make_start_time, complete_make_time, verify_time, cancel_time, cancel_reason, create_time, update_time from biz_order
mapper.insert: insert into biz_order(order_no, submit_key, user_id, shop_id, order_type, scheduled_pickup_time, order_status, pay_status, refund_status, product_amount, pack_fee, total_amount, remark, create_time) values(#{orderNo}, #{submitKey}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{orderType}, #{scheduledPickupTime}, 0, 0, 0, #{productAmount}, #{packFee}, #{totalAmount}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} and submit_key = #{submitKey} for update
mapper.update: update biz_order set order_status = #{orderStatus}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, refund_status = #{refundStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, accept_time = #{acceptTime}, pickup_token = #{pickupToken}, pickup_display = #{pickupDisplay}, pickup_date = #{pickupDate} where id = #{id} and order_status = 0 and pay_status = 0
mapper.select: where order_status = 0 and pay_status = 0 and create_time < #{deadline} and id > #{minId} order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into pickup_sequence(shop_id, pickup_date, current_seq) values(#{shopId}, #{pickupDate}, 1) on duplicate key update current_seq = current_seq + 1
mapper.select: select current_seq from pickup_sequence where shop_id = #{shopId} and pickup_date = #{pickupDate}
